title: Income-tax Act — Section 80CCD (Deduction in respect of contribution to pension scheme of Central Government)

content.overview: Section 80CCD allows a deduction from gross total income: Deduction in respect of contribution to pension scheme of Central Government.
content.glance: Section 80CCD allows a deduction from gross total income: Deduction in respect of contribution to pension scheme of Central Government.
content.study: Chapter VI-A deduction. Section 80CCD: Deduction in respect of contribution to pension scheme of Central Government. The deduction is allowed from gross total income subject to the conditions, limits and mode-of-payment rules in the section, and it cannot create a loss under the head.
